acceptanceBoundary: One accepted registry record represents one lawfully obtained and fully profiled dataset package/source family. Archives or constituent experimental subsets inside the same published package are documented but do not inflate the fully-profiled-dataset target. Measured scalar samples are counted separately from dataset packages and moulding cycles.

datasets.title: Data Model for Injection Molding and Blow Molding
datasets.notes: Blow-moulding rows were excluded. This package contributes one fully profiled dataset but no high-frequency time-series samples.

datasets.title: High-resolution injection-moulding time-series datasets (scatimdata)
datasets.notes: The source contains three published experimental datasets, but they remain one source family for the hard fully-profiled-dataset count. The sample ledger counts only observed physical numeric signal values and excludes axes, identifiers and state arrays.

datasets.title: Hot-runner molded sustainable-material experimental supplementary data
datasets.notes: The downloadable CSV has 42 analytical processing/property columns plus three leading index fields. It is accepted as one record-level measured dataset package; it does not add high-frequency waveform samples.

datasets.title: OpenMMS-T4G real-world injection-mold monitoring case study
datasets.license: BSD-3-Clause repository / CC BY 4.0 companion article
datasets.notes: The paper-linked raw CSV contains two acquisition-module clocks plus ten physical sensor channels. Only the physical sensor values count as measured scalar samples. Inertial source-scale ambiguity is explicitly retained rather than silently converted.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels
datasets.license: Current B2SHARE v2 record is Dataset Open; displayed licence field blank; no raw redistribution claimed
datasets.notes: Exact v2 Parquet MD5/SHA-256 and schema are recorded. The publisher describes 334 features but the file physically contains 364 Arrow fields; the discrepancy is preserved. SIM_* and CALC_* fields, setpoints, trigger/state arrays and aggregate summaries are not treated as direct measured waveform samples.

datasets.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels (d-optimal Design of Experiment pattern)
datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY), version not specified in EUDAT B2FIND metadata
datasets.notes: Exact Parquet MD5/SHA-256 and schema are recorded and the observed 396 fields reconcile with the publisher's feature count. Physical time-series arrays are retained as real measured evidence, but their scalar values remain outside the sample ledger until per-channel time bases and direct-measurement masks are normalized.

datasets.title: Injection Molding Dataset (Viscometer, Euromap77, Quality Table)
datasets.license: Current B2SHARE record is Dataset Open; displayed licence field blank; no raw redistribution claimed
datasets.notes: All three current B2SHARE Parquets match the publisher-displayed MD5 values. The pressure file contains 18,000,000 rows across 60 cycles, not the 1,048,575 rows implied by the description PDF; experiments 16 and 17 have no pressure traces. Only the two direct physical pressure channels count, giving 36,000,000 samples. Time and the derived pressure-difference field are excluded. EUROMAP raw-scale/documentation inconsistencies are retained without undocumented conversion.

datasets.title: Plastic road-lens injection-moulding quality dataset
datasets.license: Freely released for research and educational purposes; no broader standard data licence inferred
datasets.notes: Pinned source CSV contains 1,451 complete real-production feature vectors and four measured photometric quality classes. The README class table contains a five-row discrepancy: class 4 is 365 in the exact CSV, not 360, so the file totals 1,451 as stated. The polymer grade is not specified in the repository and remains an explicit limitation. Raw data are not redistributed outside the source's research/education terms.

datasets.title: ImPure Injection Molding Sensor Data - Trial 17th May
signals: two analog inputs with unresolved semantics
datasets.notes: All 309 exact Zenodo files matched publisher MD5 values. The 307 real cycle CSVs share one 9-column schema and contain 297,087 sampled rows with no missing sensor cells. Six named channels are clearly physical process measurements, while two analog inputs remain semantically unresolved. Source headers do not explicitly state physical units or normalize the Time-field basis, so the candidate 1,782,522 direct named values remain outside the accepted scalar-sample ledger. Separate two-cavity label and dimensional/weight files are fingerprinted as measured quality evidence.

datasets.title: FORinFPRO-HIMD multimodal hybrid injection-moulding sensor dataset
datasets.notes: Exact Zenodo v1 files are checksum-verified. European decimal-comma machine values are parsed, yielding 60 named fields, 59 numeric named fields and 35 fields classified as direct machine actuals after separating setpoints, state flags and derived/aggregate fields. The pressure/temperature file has 403 rows and the ultrasound-RMS file 2,154 rows. The published CSV headers do not explicitly state physical units or normalize the physical time basis, so no scalar values are added to the accepted measured-sample ledger. The one deeply instrumented visible moulding cycle counts as one dataset package, not multiple packages.

datasets.title: Cross-process-chain injection moulding and screw-driving archive
signals: pressure target and process state retained separately
datasets.notes: The exact 685.5 MB v1.1 archive matched the publisher MD5 and contains 30,572 files. Only 15,686 upper/lower injection-moulding serial recordings count as injection evidence; 14,882 screw-driving JSON files are excluded. Seven lower static-table filenames are absent from the checksum-matched archive and are retained as a source-quality limitation. Raw serial headers omit physical units and per-file timing varies, so waveform scalars remain outside the measured-sample ledger.

datasets.title: Graphite nanoplatelet enhanced HDPE injection-moulding experiments
datasets.notes: Exact Mendeley v3 files are SHA-256 fingerprinted. The peer-reviewed Data in Brief companion reconciles 35 injection-moulding experiments with GNP content, injection temperature in degC, injection pressure in MPa, and measured tensile modulus, toughness and Vickers hardness. Derived Random-Forest and decision-tree artefacts do not inflate the experimental record count.

datasets.title: Data-driven energy efficiency in injection molding: production and energy data fusion
datasets.sampling: per-device LOG_TIME deltas cluster around 5 seconds; zero timestamp parse failures and zero non-positive per-device deltas in the two raw production streams
datasets.notes: Exact Zenodo v1 CSV bytes match publisher MD5 and pinned SHA-256 fingerprints. February and March raw production streams contain 1,269,887 observations on injection machine FGP085. Fifteen direct instrument-reported Shelly Pro 3EM phase channels are counted, yielding 19,048,305 scalar samples. Power factor and aggregate total fields are excluded as derived/aggregate, N_CURRENT is unpopulated, and the separate 2,901-row test dataset is excluded to avoid possible overlap/double counting.
